modules.html:
Why a root canal is the best solution for tooth pain

Severe tooth pain can disrupt your day, your sleep, and your peace of mind. When decay or infection reaches the inner layer of the tooth, a root canal is often the only predictable, long-lasting way to save your natural tooth and stop the infection from spreading.

At My Dear Dentist, your Montrose root canal dentists, Dr. Nour Amin and Dr. Mustafa Shinta, use advanced technology and a comfort-first approach to ensure your visit is smooth, gentle, and stress-free. We remove the infected pulp, disinfect the tooth, and seal it with precision, restoring your tooth’s strength while protecting your overall health.

A healthier smile is possible, and relief is closer than you think.
Root canal treatment can…
Save your natural tooth and avoid unnecessary extractions
Eliminate pain caused by infection, inflammation, or decay
Stop the spread of bacteria before it affects other teeth or your body
Protect your long-term oral health and bite stability
FAQs

items.title: Do we really need root canals?
items.html: If a tooth is infected, a root canal is often the only way to save it. Leaving it untreated can cause increased pain, swelling, and even systemic health concerns.

items.title: How long do root canals last?
items.html: With proper care and regular checkups, a root canal can last a lifetime. Most patients forget they ever had the procedure.

items.title: Is pulling the tooth easier than getting a root canal?
items.html: Not usually. While extractions can seem quicker, they often require more long-term treatment, like implants or bridges, to replace the missing tooth. A root canal preserves what nature gave you.

items.title: What’s recovery like?
items.html: Most patients feel significantly better within 24–48 hours. Mild soreness is normal but manageable with over-the-counter relief.

items.title: How do I know if I need a root canal?
items.html:
Watch for:

  • Sharp or throbbing pain
  • Sensitivity to temperature
  • Swelling or tenderness
  • A pimple-like bump on the gums
  • Pain when chewing

Our Montrose root canal dentists can confirm with a diagnostic exam and x-rays.

modules.html:
A root canal that restores & protects

  • Assessing the damage: We evaluate your symptoms and use digital x-rays to determine the source of your pain.
  • Pain-free treatment: Local anesthesia, gentle techniques, and a calm environment support a low-stress visit.
  • Eliminating the infection: We carefully remove bacteria and damaged tissue to save your natural tooth.
  • Sealing & strengthening: A filling or crown protects your tooth and restores full function.
  • Preserving your smile: Keeping your natural tooth helps maintain jaw health, stability, and your long-term comfort.
